cell.label: Suspect HG in pregnant woman with intractable vomiting, onset at <10 weeks' gestation, and >5% weight loss compared with prepregnancy weight.
Check electrolytes, urinalysis, TSH/T4, LFTs, BUN/creatinine; obtain ultrasound to assess for multiple gestation and molar pregnancy.
Offer ginger, vitamin B6, doxylamine, p6 acupressure.
Treat with antiemetics, IV fluid hydration, and electrolyte replacement; consider steroids.
Consider hospitalization, total parenteral nutrition (TPN), specialist consultation.
Treat any underlying disease or abnormalities.
